text: ensure_not_stale runs after files are written; stale error leaves half-applied mutation

Fixed on worktree branch: Tracker.begin_write gates every write (write_issue, EventLog.append/move_file) with ensure_not_stale before the first write and records touched paths; commit_if_needed calls discard_pending (git checkout HEAD for tracked paths, unlink for untracked) on a stale failure. Tests: TestStaleTracker (4 cases: pre-write detection + note/state-move/create rollback). scripts/dev/check: all green, 161 tests.
